# Entity submodule

> **Preview:** This submodule manages `Microsoft.CloudHealth/healthmodels/entities@2026-05-01-preview`.

Creates one typed health model entity, including Azure metric, PromQL, KQL, Resource Health, dependency, alert, and embedded-health-model configuration.
